exclusion_rule.contract: The training pipeline MUST import heldout_rule.is_trainable and drop every document for which it returns False. This excludes the whole bucket, including documents in shards this builder never opened.

limitations: Token counts are NOT recorded here; they depend on the final tokenizer choice and must be computed after the base model is locked.
Benchmark decontamination against ThaiExam/M3Exam is a SEPARATE step and has not run yet.
Streamed from the first shards only; this is a held-out sample, not a stratified sample of the whole corpus.
